function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of the **next few major festivals happening in the United States** (as of June 2026).  Dates are approximate and can shift slightly each year, so be sure to double‑check the official websites for the most up‑to‑date information.

| Festival | City / State | Typical Dates (2026) | Highlights | Official Site |
|----------|--------------|----------------------|------------|---------------|
| **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival** | Manchester, Tennessee | **June 15–18** | Multi‑genre music, art installations, yoga, and a “Bonnaroo Village” with food trucks and craft vendors. | [bonnaroo.com](https://www.bonnaroo.com) |
| **Summerfest** | Milwaukee, Wisconsin | **July 1–10** | The world’s largest music festival, featuring 200+ stages, 800+ acts, and a wide range of genres. | [summerfest.com](https://www.summerfest.com) |
| **Lollapalooza** | Chicago, Illinois | **August 4–7** | One of the biggest pop‑rock festivals in the U.S., with headliners from indie, hip‑hop, and electronic music. | [lollapalooza.com](https://www.lollapalooza.com) |
| **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | New Orleans, Louisiana | **August 12–14** | Celebrates jazz, blues, and Creole music, plus Cajun, zydeco, and world‑music acts. | [nojazzfest.com](https://www.nojazzfest.com) |
| **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** | Indio, California | **October 6–9** | Iconic desert festival featuring top‑tier rock, hip‑hop, indie, and electronic acts, plus art installations. | [coachella.com](https://www.coachella.com) |

### How to Find the “Next” Festival

If you’re looking for the very next festival after today (June 23, 2026), **Bonnaroo** is the closest major event, kicking off on June 15. If you’re interested in a smaller or niche festival, you can check local event calendars or sites like Songkick, Bandsintown, or Eventbrite for city‑specific festivals that may be happening in the coming weeks.

### Quick Tips

- **Tickets**: Most festivals sell tickets in advance. Check the official site for early‑bird pricing and VIP packages.
- **Travel & Accommodation**: Book lodging and transportation early—especially for festivals in popular destinations like Coachella or Summerfest.
- **Weather**: For outdoor festivals, keep an eye on local weather forecasts. The Open‑Meteo API can give you up‑to‑date weather for the festival location if you’d like to plan accordingly.

Let me know if you’d like more details on a specific festival, or if you’re interested in a particular genre or region!
